subject: Chemistry
source_note: TIE (2023), Chemistry Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic concepts, theories and principles in Chemistry

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of concepts, theories and principles in Chemistry
competences: (a) Describe the concept of Chemistry (meaning, branches, applications and relationships with other disciplines)
(b) Discuss the contribution of Chemistry in the development of modern society
(c) Describe the concept of matter (physical and chemical changes of matter)
(d) Describe the concepts of chemical elements (criteria for assigning chemical symbols), compounds (binary compound) and mixtures (types of solution and separation of mixtures)
(e) Compare the properties of compounds with those of constituent elements
(f) Explain the concept of the periodic table (1st 20 elements in the Periodic Table; metals and non-metals)

objectives.text: (a) Describe the concept of Chemistry (meaning, branches, applications and relationships with other disciplines)
objectives.resources: Pictures, diagrams, simulations, animations or videos illustrating the meaning, branches, applications and relationship with other disciplines
objectives.assessment_criteria: The concept of Chemistry is clearly described

objectives.text: (b) Discuss the contribution of Chemistry in the development of modern society
objectives.resources: Simulations, animations or videos illustrating the contribution of Chemistry in the development of modern society
objectives.assessment_criteria: The contribution of Chemistry in the development of modern society is clearly recognised

objectives.text: (c) Describe the concept of matter (physical and chemical changes of matter)
objectives.resources: Ice, water, source of heat, evaporating basin, metal nails,beaker, table salt, sugar, iodine crystals, magnet, magnesium ribbon, acids, fruits, paper, CuSO 4 solution, aluminium foil, candle, CaCO , 3 Pb(NO ) 3 2 solution and simulations and videos illustrating physical and chemical changes of matter
objectives.assessment_criteria: The concept of matter is clearly described

objectives.text: (d) Describe the concepts of chemical elements (criteria for assigning chemical symbols), compounds (binary compound) and mixtures (types of solution and separation of mixtures)
objectives.resources: Periodic table, copper, zinc, aluminium, iron, sulphur, hydrogen, common salt, iron filings, magnet, powdered sulphur, crucible and lid, heat source, HCl solution, water, chalk FeS, milk, clay soil,
objectives.assessment_criteria: The concepts of chemical elements, compounds and mixture are clearly described

objectives.text: (e) Compare the properties of compounds with those of constituent elements
objectives.resources: margarine, filter paper, funnel, ethanol, iodine crystals, kerosene, ink, sugar, wall charts, and pictures of distillers
objectives.assessment_criteria: The properties of compounds are correctly compared with those of constituent elements

objectives.text: (f) Explain the concept of the periodic table (1st 20 elements in the Periodic Table; metals and non-metals)
objectives.resources: Diagrams, pictures, wall charts, simulations and videos illustrating 1st 20 elements in the Periodic Table; metals and non-metals
objectives.assessment_criteria: The concept of the periodic table is clearly explained

sub_topics.title: Conduct experiments in Chemistry
competences: (a) Describe basic Chemistry laboratory skills (chemistry laboratory rules and safety measures, first aid, fire and firefighting, and Chemistry laboratory apparatus)
(b) Perform experiments on the changes of matter from one state to another
(c) Perform experiments on separation of different mixtures using different methods

objectives.text: (a) Describe basic Chemistry laboratory skills (chemistry laboratory rules and safety measures, first aid, fire and firefighting, and Chemistry laboratory apparatus)
objectives.teaching_methods: Group discussion, Guest speaker from fire brigade, Outdoor activity
objectives.resources: Laboratory manuals, models, pictures, wall charts with written laboratory rules, first aid kit, laboratory apparatus, fire extinguishers and videos illustrating basic chemistry laboratory skills
objectives.assessment_criteria: Basic Chemistry laboratory skills are clearly described

objectives.text: (b) Perform experiments on the changes of matter from one state to another
objectives.resources: Ice, water, iron chips, heat source, clay soil, margarine, filter paper, funnel, iodine crystals, anhydrous CuSO 4 kerosene, salt and sugar
objectives.assessment_criteria: Experiments on the changes of matter from one state to another are correctly performed

objectives.text: (c) Perform experiments on separation of different mixtures using different methods
objectives.teaching_methods: Home-based project, Experimentation, Questions and answers
objectives.resources: Common salt, iron filings, magnet, powdered Sulphur, crucible and lid, heat source, HCl solution, FeS, milk, clay soil, margarine, kerosene, filter paper, funnel, ethanol, kerosene, ink, sugar, distillation system and animations or videos illustrating separation of different mixtures using different methods
objectives.assessment_criteria: Experiments on separation of different mixtures using different methods are correctly performed
